steps.action: Zelle is a first-class destination (bottom-nav tab or Pay & Transfer tile) inside a money-movement hub that explains when to use Zelle vs instant transfer vs wire; assistant can open the flow
steps.rationale: WF bottom-nav tab and BofA hub tile minimise taps; Javelin notes hubs still fail to guide rail choice, so the composite adds the explainer.

steps.action: One-screen token enrollment with one-time code; transfer of an existing enrollment from another bank supported
steps.rationale: Single enrollment with OTP and enrollment portability removes the most common first-use failure.

steps.action: Add recipient from synced contacts, token, Zelle tag or QR; registered name shown before saving, with an explicit warning when it does not match the address-book name and a 'new recipient' badge
steps.rationale: Fifth Third is the only bank documenting a name-mismatch warning; WF/USB/BofA show the enrolled name. Together they are the strongest wrong-recipient control.

steps.action: Amount, funding account, memo, future date or recurring toggle in one screen, with remaining daily/30-day limit shown before entry
steps.rationale: WF 'Repeat payment' toggle and JPM/USB in-flow limit display.

steps.action: Risk-tiered scam intervention: for new recipients or risk signals (social-media origin, changed token, high amount) ask payment purpose and contact origin, then show a full-screen warning with irrevocability acknowledgement; low-risk repeat payments skip it
steps.rationale: Chase purpose/origin questions (Mar 2025) plus U.S. Bank's explicit APP-scam copy and checkbox; risk-tiering avoids U.S. Bank's every-send double screen.

steps.action: Step-up one-time code only for first payment to a new recipient or elevated risk; customer taps Send
steps.rationale: Targeted OTP adds friction only where scam exposure is highest.

steps.action: Explicit status states with next-step copy: Pending acceptance (recipient not enrolled, cancellable), Pending review (bank hold, with expected timing), Completed
steps.rationale: BofA publishes the fullest Zelle state vocabulary; the composite adds expected timing to 'Pending review'.

steps.action: Confirmation with recipient registered name, token, amount, time; push + email to sender; recipient notified by network
steps.rationale: Multi-channel confirmation is table stakes; WF adds secure-inbox copy.

steps.action: Activity with cancel while recipient unenrolled; edit/skip/cancel scheduled and recurring series until a published cutoff; long searchable history
steps.rationale: WF skip-one or cancel-series until 11:30 PM PT with 24-month activity; U.S. Bank 18-month search.

steps.action: In-app 'Report a problem' on the transaction branching unauthorized (Reg E timeline shown) vs scam (imposter eligibility check, network recovery request), with a claim status tracker in-app
steps.rationale: BofA consumer claims are trackable in-app (Status Tracker) and TD added a Disputes Center (2026); no bank yet offers in-app Zelle scam intake, so intake is composite.

steps.action: Virtual assistant locates the payment, explains status and hands off to a specialist with context; one published fraud/scam number
steps.rationale: Erica is cited by Javelin/Forrester as the money-movement aide; Fargo can view Zelle activity.

title: Consumer sends money to a new recipient with Zelle (mobile-first)

steps.action: 'Zelle for your business' inside the business app/online banking profile
steps.rationale: Business enrollment in the same app as consumer.

steps.action: Create a Zelle tag and a printable/shareable QR showing the business name
steps.rationale: Tag + printable QR is the SMB acceptance standard since Sep 2025.

steps.action: Customer pays the tag/QR from any bank app; business can request by email/mobile
steps.rationale: Privacy-preserving acceptance.

steps.action: Payer sees the verified business name; business-initiated sends follow the account's approval policy (secondary approver above threshold)
steps.rationale: No bank applies dual approval to business Zelle; composite borrows Chase's approval queue pattern.

steps.action: Funds land in minutes; activity searchable
steps.rationale: Standard.

steps.action: Receipt notification with payer and memo; exportable for reconciliation
steps.rationale: Accounting export absent at all ten banks; composite element.

steps.action: Manage tags and tokens, block payers; assistant can manage tags
steps.rationale: Erica manages business Zelle tags.

steps.action: Refund flow and a published business imposter-scam reimbursement position
steps.rationale: Fifth Third is the only bank stating business imposter-scam reimbursement.

steps.action: Dedicated business Zelle line
steps.rationale: PNC publishes a Zelle for Business number.

title: Small business gets paid with a Zelle tag/QR and pays vendors under controls
